build.beforeBuildCommand: node scripts/tauri-prebuild.mjs && node scripts/tauri-postbuild.mjs && node scripts/post-build-cleanup.mjs && node scripts/patch-android-manifest.mjs

security.csp: default-src 'self' tauri: https: blob:; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https://js.paystack.co https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; connect-src 'self' https: wss: blob:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; media-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com https://www.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; frame-src 'self' https://checkout.paystack.com https://js.paystack.co;
